items.prompt: I ___ to school by bus every morning.

hints.he: every morning מראה על הרגל. איזה זמן מתאים להרגלים?
hints.en: every morning shows a habit. Which tense is for habits?

hints.he: עם I לא מוסיפים s, וגם לא צריך am.
hints.en: With I there is no -s and no am.

explanation.he: הרגל קבוע = Present Simple. עם I הפועל בצורת הבסיס: I go. לא מוסיפים am לפני פועל רגיל.
explanation.en: A habit uses the Present Simple. With I, use the base verb: I go. Do not add am before a normal verb.

items.audioText: I go to school by bus every morning.

items.prompt: We ___ basketball on Tuesdays.

hints.he: on Tuesdays = כל יום שלישי. זה הרגל.
hints.en: on Tuesdays = every Tuesday. It is a habit.

hints.he: we הולך עם פועל בלי s.
hints.en: we takes a verb without -s.

explanation.he: הרגל = Present Simple. עם we משתמשים בפועל בסיס: We play. לא מכניסים are לפני פועל רגיל.
explanation.en: A habit uses the Present Simple. With we, use the base verb: We play. No are before a normal verb.

items.audioText: We play basketball on Tuesdays.

items.prompt: My dad ___ coffee every morning, but today he is drinking tea.

hints.he: יש כאן שני חלקים: every morning ו־today. לאיזה חלק שייך הרווח?
hints.en: There are two parts: every morning and today. Which part has the gap?

hints.he: every morning = הרגל. my dad = he.
hints.en: every morning = a habit. my dad = he.

explanation.he: every morning מראה הרגל, ולכן Present Simple. my dad הוא he, ולכן drinks עם s. החלק של today מתאר משהו זמני, ושם יש is drinking.
explanation.en: every morning shows a habit, so use the Present Simple. my dad is he, so drinks. The today part is temporary, so it uses is drinking.

items.audioText: My dad drinks coffee every morning, but today he is drinking tea.

items.prompt: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.

hints.he: זו עובדה מדעית שתמיד נכונה.
hints.en: This is a scientific fact that is always true.

hints.he: water = it.
hints.en: water = it.

explanation.he: עובדות שתמיד נכונות באות ב־Present Simple. water הוא it, ולכן boils עם s.
explanation.en: Facts that are always true use the Present Simple. water is it, so boils with -s.

items.audioText: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.

items.prompt: I usually ___ my homework after lunch.

hints.he: usually היא מילה של הרגל.
hints.en: usually is a habit word.

hints.he: עם I לא צריך am לפני פועל רגיל.
hints.en: With I you do not need am before a normal verb.

explanation.he: usually, always, often מראות הרגל ובאות עם Present Simple: I usually do my homework.
explanation.en: usually, always and often show a habit and go with the Present Simple: I usually do my homework.

items.audioText: I usually do my homework after lunch.

items.prompt: The train to Haifa ___ at 8:15 every morning.

hints.he: every morning: זה לוח זמנים קבוע.
hints.en: every morning: this is a fixed timetable.

hints.he: the train = it.
hints.en: the train = it.

explanation.he: לוח זמנים קבוע (רכבות, שיעורים) בא ב־Present Simple. the train הוא it, ולכן leaves.
explanation.en: A fixed timetable uses the Present Simple. the train is it, so leaves.

items.audioText: The train to Haifa leaves at 8:15 every morning.

items.prompt: Tom ___ in a bank. He is a cashier.

hints.he: מדובר בעבודה הקבועה של Tom.
hints.en: This is Tom's regular job.

hints.he: Tom = he. מה מוסיפים לפועל?
hints.en: Tom = he. What do we add to the verb?

explanation.he: עבודה קבועה = Present Simple. Tom הוא he, ולכן works. בעברית אומרים "הוא עובד", אבל באנגלית לא מוסיפים is לפני פועל רגיל.
explanation.en: A regular job uses the Present Simple. Tom is he, so works. Do not add is before a normal verb.

items.audioText: Tom works in a bank. He is a cashier.

items.prompt: My sister ___ English very well, so she often helps me with my homework. (speak)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: כמעט. my sister זה she, ולכן מוסיפים s.
feedback.en: Almost. my sister is she, so add -s.

hints.he: my sister = she. מה קורה לפועל אחרי she?
hints.en: my sister = she. What happens to the verb after she?

explanation.he: he, she, it בהווה פשוט: מוסיפים s לפועל. She speaks.
explanation.en: With he, she, it in the Present Simple, add -s: She speaks.

items.audioText: My sister speaks English very well, so she often helps me with my homework.

items.prompt: He ___ his teeth twice a day. (brush)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: With he, add an ending to the verb.
Almost. After sh, add -es.

hints.he: he = גוף שלישי. ומה עם הסיומת sh?
hints.en: he = third person. What about the ending sh?

explanation.he: פועל שמסתיים ב־sh, ch, s, x, o מקבל es: brushes.
explanation.en: Verbs ending in sh, ch, s, x, o take -es: brushes.

items.audioText: He brushes his teeth twice a day.

items.prompt: She ___ math for two hours every day. (study)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: With she, add an ending to the verb.
Almost. Consonant + y becomes -ies.

hints.he: she = גוף שלישי. ומה קורה ל־y בסוף?
hints.en: she = third person. What happens to the final y?

explanation.he: עיצור + y בסוף: מורידים y ומוסיפים ies. study → studies.
explanation.en: Consonant + y: drop y and add -ies. study → studies.

items.audioText: She studies math for two hours every day.

items.prompt: Every day, our cat ___ for hours on the sofa. (sleep)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: our cat זה it, ולכן מוסיפים s.
feedback.en: our cat is it, so add -s.

hints.he: our cat = it.
hints.en: our cat = it.

explanation.he: it בהווה פשוט: מוסיפים s. The cat sleeps.
explanation.en: With it in the Present Simple, add -s: The cat sleeps.

items.audioText: Every day, our cat sleeps for hours on the sofa.

items.prompt: My grandmother ___ to the market every Friday. (go)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: my grandmother זה she, ולכן צריך סיומת.
feedback.en: my grandmother is she, so add an ending.
Almost. After o, add -es.

hints.he: my grandmother = she. go מסתיים ב־o.
hints.en: my grandmother = she. go ends in o.

explanation.he: פועל שמסתיים ב־o מקבל es: go → goes, do → does.
explanation.en: Verbs ending in o take -es: go → goes, do → does.

items.audioText: My grandmother goes to the market every Friday.

items.prompt: Every weekend, he ___ a lot of homework, so he never goes out. (do)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: With he you need an ending.

feedback.he: כמעט. אחרי o מוסיפים es: does.
feedback.en: Almost. After o, add -es: does.

hints.he: he = גוף שלישי. do מסתיים ב־o.
hints.en: he = third person. do ends in o.

explanation.he: do עם he, she, it הופך ל־does.
explanation.en: do with he, she, it becomes does.

items.audioText: Every weekend, he does a lot of homework, so he never goes out.

items.prompt: She ___ two brothers. They are both older than her. (have)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: With she, have changes.

feedback.he: have הוא חריג. עם she אומרים has.
feedback.en: have is irregular. With she, say has.

hints.he: have משתנה בגוף שלישי לצורה מיוחדת.
hints.en: have has a special form in the third person.

explanation.he: have עם he, she, it הופך ל־has. She has two brothers.
explanation.en: have with he, she, it becomes has: She has two brothers.

items.audioText: She has two brothers. They are both older than her.

items.prompt: Dana always ___ her best in every game, and her coach is proud of her. (try)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: Dana זה she, ולכן צריך סיומת.
feedback.en: Dana is she, so add an ending.
Almost. Consonant + y becomes -ies.

hints.he: Dana = she. מה קורה ל־y אחרי עיצור?
hints.en: Dana = she. What happens to y after a consonant?

explanation.he: try → tries: עיצור + y הופך ל־ies. אבל play → plays, כי לפני y יש תנועה.
explanation.en: try → tries: consonant + y becomes -ies. But play → plays, because a vowel comes before y.

items.audioText: Dana always tries her best in every game, and her coach is proud of her.

items.prompt: The shop ___ at nine o'clock every evening. (close)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: the shop זה it, ולכן מוסיפים s.
feedback.en: the shop is it, so add -s.

hints.he: the shop = it.
hints.en: the shop = it.

explanation.he: the shop הוא it. ב־Present Simple מוסיפים s: closes.
explanation.en: the shop is it. In the Present Simple add -s: closes.

items.audioText: The shop closes at nine o'clock every evening.

items.prompt: Noa ___ in Tel Aviv.

hints.he: Noa = she.
hints.en: Noa = she.

hints.he: צריך פועל אחד בהווה פשוט, עם סיומת.
hints.en: You need one verb in the Present Simple, with an ending.

explanation.he: Noa היא she, ולכן lives עם s. לא מוסיפים is לפני פועל רגיל.
explanation.en: Noa is she, so lives with -s. Do not add is before a normal verb.

items.audioText: Noa lives in Tel Aviv.

items.prompt: Every morning, my brother ___ the dog for a walk.

hints.he: every morning = הרגל. my brother = he.
hints.en: every morning = a habit. my brother = he.

explanation.he: הרגל = Present Simple. my brother הוא he, ולכן takes.
explanation.en: A habit uses the Present Simple. my brother is he, so takes.

items.audioText: Every morning, my brother takes the dog for a walk.

items.prompt: The bus ___ past our school every ten minutes.

hints.he: the bus = it. ואיך מוסיפים סיומת ל־go?
hints.en: the bus = it. How do we add the ending to go?

explanation.he: the bus הוא it. go מסתיים ב־o, ולכן מקבל es: goes.
explanation.en: the bus is it. go ends in o, so it takes -es: goes.

items.audioText: The bus goes past our school every ten minutes.

items.prompt: ___ you like chocolate?

hints.he: like הוא פועל רגיל. צריך פועל עזר לשאלה.
hints.en: like is a normal verb. The question needs a helping verb.

hints.he: you הולך עם do.
hints.en: you goes with do.

explanation.he: שאלה בהווה פשוט: Do / Does + נושא + פועל בסיס. עם you משתמשים ב־Do. בעברית שואלים רק בעזרת הטון, ולכן קל לשכוח את Do.
explanation.en: A Present Simple question: Do / Does + subject + base verb. With you, use Do.

items.audioText: Do you like chocolate?

items.prompt: ___ your brother play the guitar?

hints.he: your brother = he.
hints.en: your brother = he.

explanation.he: עם he, she, it שואלים עם Does: Does your brother play...?
explanation.en: With he, she, it, ask with Does: Does your brother play...?

items.audioText: Does your brother play the guitar?

items.prompt: She ___ eat meat. She is a vegetarian.

hints.he: eat הוא פועל רגיל. איך עושים לו שלילה?
hints.en: eat is a normal verb. How do we make it negative?

hints.he: she הולך עם does.
hints.en: she goes with does.

explanation.he: שלילה בהווה פשוט: don't / doesn't + פועל בסיס. עם she: doesn't eat.
explanation.en: Present Simple negative: don't / doesn't + base verb. With she: doesn't eat.

items.audioText: She doesn't eat meat. She is a vegetarian.

items.prompt: Does he ___ near the school?

hints.he: does כבר מראה שזה he.
hints.en: does already shows it is he.

explanation.he: אחרי does הפועל בצורת הבסיס, בלי s: Does he live...? ה־s כבר נמצאת ב־does.
explanation.en: After does, use the base verb without -s: Does he live...? The -s is already in does.

items.audioText: Does he live near the school?

items.prompt: My parents ___ watch TV in the morning.

hints.he: my parents = they.
hints.en: my parents = they.

explanation.he: my parents הם they, ולכן don't + פועל בסיס.
explanation.en: my parents is they, so don't + base verb.

items.audioText: My parents don't watch TV in the morning.

items.prompt: Where ___ your aunt work?

hints.he: your aunt = she. work הוא פועל רגיל.
hints.en: your aunt = she. work is a normal verb.

explanation.he: שאלה עם מילת שאלה: Where + does + she + פועל בסיס. your aunt היא she, ולכן does.
explanation.en: Wh- question: Where + does + she + base verb. your aunt is she, so does.

items.audioText: Where does your aunt work?

items.prompt: Which question is correct?

hints.he: בשאלה עם פועל רגיל צריך פועל עזר.
hints.en: A question with a normal verb needs a helping verb.

explanation.he: בעברית שואלים בלי פועל עזר. באנגלית צריך do: Where do you live?
explanation.en: In Hebrew there is no helping verb. In English you need do: Where do you live?

items.audioText: Where do you live?

items.prompt: My dad doesn't ___ coffee. (drink)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After doesn't, do not add -s.

hints.he: איזו צורה של הפועל באה אחרי doesn't?
hints.en: Which verb form comes after doesn't?

explanation.he: doesn't + פועל בסיס: doesn't drink. ה־s כבר נמצאת ב־doesn't.
explanation.en: doesn't + base verb: doesn't drink. The -s is already in doesn't.

items.audioText: My dad doesn't drink coffee.

items.prompt: What time ___ the movie start tonight? (do)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: the movie זה it, ולכן צריך does.
feedback.en: the movie is it, so use does.

hints.he: the movie = it.
hints.en: the movie = it.

explanation.he: שאלה עם it: does + פועל בסיס. What time does the movie start?
explanation.en: Question with it: does + base verb. What time does the movie start?

items.audioText: What time does the movie start tonight?

items.prompt: She doesn't ___ to come with us. She has a lot of homework.

hints.he: מה בא אחרי doesn't?
hints.en: What comes after doesn't?

explanation.he: אחרי doesn't בא פועל בסיס: She doesn't want to come.
explanation.en: After doesn't use the base verb: She doesn't want to come.

items.audioText: She doesn't want to come with us. She has a lot of homework.

items.prompt: Look! The children ___ in the garden.

hints.he: Look! מראה שזה קורה עכשיו.
hints.en: Look! shows it is happening now.

hints.he: the children = they.
hints.en: the children = they.

explanation.he: פעולה שקורית עכשיו: am / is / are + ing. בעברית אין צורה מיוחדת להווה מתמשך, ולכן קל לבחור play. באנגלית: are playing.
explanation.en: An action happening now: am / is / are + -ing. The children are playing.

items.audioText: Look! The children are playing in the garden.

items.prompt: Shh! The baby ___ right now.

hints.he: right now = עכשיו.
hints.en: right now = at this moment.

hints.he: the baby = it. צריך פועל עזר וגם סיומת.
hints.en: the baby = it. You need a helping verb and an ending.

explanation.he: עכשיו = Present Progressive: is sleeping. בלי is המשפט לא שלם.
explanation.en: Now = Present Progressive: is sleeping. Without is the sentence is not complete.

items.audioText: Shh! The baby is sleeping right now.

items.prompt: Listen! Someone is ___ at the door. (knock)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After is you need the -ing form.

hints.he: Listen! = זה קורה עכשיו. מה מוסיפים לפועל אחרי is?
hints.en: Listen! = it is happening now. What do we add after is?

explanation.he: is + פועל + ing: is knocking.
explanation.en: is + verb + -ing: is knocking.

items.audioText: Listen! Someone is knocking at the door.

items.prompt: It is ___ outside, so take an umbrella. (rain)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After is you need the -ing form.
Do not double the n in rain.

hints.he: זה קורה עכשיו. איזו סיומת חסרה?
hints.en: It is happening now. Which ending is missing?

explanation.he: It is raining: is + ing לפעולה שקורית עכשיו.
explanation.en: It is raining: is + -ing for an action happening now.

items.audioText: It is raining outside, so take an umbrella.

items.prompt: We are ___ for a bus at the moment. (wait)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After are you need the -ing form.

feedback.he: ב־wait לא מכפילים את t, כי יש שתי תנועות לפניה.
feedback.en: Do not double the t in wait. It has two vowels before it.

hints.he: at the moment = עכשיו.
hints.en: at the moment = now.

explanation.he: are + ing: are waiting.
explanation.en: are + -ing: are waiting.

items.audioText: We are waiting for a bus at the moment.

items.prompt: She is ___ a letter to her friend now. (write)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: כמעט. מורידים את ה־e לפני ing.
feedback.en: Almost. Drop the e before -ing.
After is you need the -ing form.

hints.he: write מסתיים ב־e שקטה.
hints.en: write ends in a silent e.

explanation.he: פועל שמסתיים ב־e שקטה: מורידים e ומוסיפים ing. write → writing.
explanation.en: Verb ending in silent e: drop e, add -ing. write → writing.

items.audioText: She is writing a letter to her friend now.

items.prompt: They are ___ in the sea right now. (swim)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: Almost. Double the m.
After are you need the -ing form.

hints.he: swim: עיצור, תנועה קצרה, עיצור. מה עושים לאות האחרונה?
hints.en: swim: consonant, short vowel, consonant. What happens to the last letter?

explanation.he: מילה קצרה שמסתיימת בעיצור + תנועה + עיצור: מכפילים את העיצור האחרון. swim → swimming.
explanation.en: Short verb ending consonant + vowel + consonant: double the last letter. swim → swimming.

items.audioText: They are swimming in the sea right now.

items.prompt: He is ___ on the floor because there are no chairs. (sit)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: Almost. Double the t.
After is you need the -ing form.

hints.he: sit: עיצור, תנועה קצרה, עיצור.
hints.en: sit: consonant, short vowel, consonant.

explanation.he: sit → sitting: מכפילים את העיצור האחרון.
explanation.en: sit → sitting: double the last consonant.

items.audioText: He is sitting on the floor because there are no chairs.

items.prompt: What ___ you doing right now?

hints.he: doing ו־right now: איזה פועל עזר בא עם ing?
hints.en: doing and right now: which helping verb goes with -ing?

explanation.he: שאלה ב־Present Progressive: What + are + you + ing. do בא רק עם פועל בסיס.
explanation.en: Present Progressive question: What + are + you + -ing. do goes only with a base verb.

items.audioText: What are you doing right now?

items.prompt: I ___ to music now, so I can't hear you.

hints.he: now = עכשיו.
hints.en: now = at this moment.

hints.he: צריך פועל עזר שמתאים ל־I, וגם סיומת.
hints.en: You need a helping verb for I, and an ending.

explanation.he: פעולה שקורית עכשיו: I am listening.
explanation.en: An action happening now: I am listening.

items.audioText: I am listening to music now, so I can't hear you.

items.prompt: I ___ the answer to this question.

hints.he: know הוא פועל של מצב בראש, לא פעולה.
hints.en: know is a state of mind, not an action.

explanation.he: פעלי מצב כמו know, like, want, understand לא באים בדרך כלל ב־ing, גם כשמדברים על עכשיו: I know.
explanation.en: State verbs like know, like, want and understand usually have no -ing form, even about now: I know.

items.audioText: I know the answer to this question.

items.prompt: This bag ___ to my brother.

hints.he: belong מתאר מצב של בעלות.
hints.en: belong describes owning something.

explanation.he: belong הוא פועל מצב, ולכן Present Simple: This bag belongs to my brother.
explanation.en: belong is a state verb, so use the Present Simple: This bag belongs to my brother.

items.audioText: This bag belongs to my brother.

items.prompt: Right now, she ___ a new phone, but she doesn't have enough money.

hints.he: גם עם right now, want הוא פועל מצב.
hints.en: Even with right now, want is a state verb.

explanation.he: want לא בא ב־ing, גם כשמדברים על עכשיו. she הוא גוף שלישי, ולכן wants.
explanation.en: want does not take -ing, even about now. With she: wants.

items.audioText: Right now, she wants a new phone, but she doesn't have enough money.

items.prompt: I ___ what you mean now. Thanks for explaining.

hints.he: understand הוא פועל של חשיבה, לא פעולה שרואים.
hints.en: understand is a thinking verb, not a visible action.

explanation.he: understand הוא פועל מצב. גם עם now אומרים I understand.
explanation.en: understand is a state verb. Even with now, say I understand.

items.audioText: I understand what you mean now. Thanks for explaining.

items.prompt: Be quiet, please. I ___ to concentrate.

hints.he: Be quiet מראה שזה קורה ברגע הזה.
hints.en: Be quiet shows it is happening at this moment.

explanation.he: מנסים להתרכז עכשיו, ולכן am trying. בעברית "אני מנסה" משמש גם להווה מתמשך.

items.prompt: When I arrived, the guests were ___ and laughing. (dance)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: כמעט. מורידים את ה־e לפני ing.
feedback.en: Almost. Drop the e before -ing.

feedback.he: אחרי were בפעולה מתמשכת צריך ing.
feedback.en: After were in a continuous action you need -ing.

hints.he: גם laughing בא עם ing.
hints.en: laughing also has -ing.

explanation.he: were dancing and laughing: שתי פעולות שהיו באמצע כשהגעתי.
explanation.en: were dancing and laughing: two actions in progress when I arrived.

items.audioText: When I arrived, the guests were dancing and laughing.

items.prompt: Dan ___ his leg while he was skiing.

hints.he: איזו פעולה קצרה ופתאומית?
hints.en: Which action is short and sudden?

explanation.he: הפעולה הקצרה (שבירת הרגל) באה ב־Past Simple: broke. הפעולה הארוכה (skiing) ב־Past Progressive.
explanation.en: The short action uses the Past Simple: broke. The long action uses the Past Progressive: was skiing.

items.audioText: Dan broke his leg while he was skiing.

items.prompt: As I ___ home, I noticed a strange light in the sky.

hints.he: as כאן = בזמן ש.
hints.en: as here = while.

explanation.he: as = while. הפעולה הארוכה ב־Past Progressive: I was walking. עם I משתמשים ב־was.
explanation.en: as = while. The long action is Past Progressive: I was walking. I goes with was.

items.audioText: As I was walking home, I noticed a strange light in the sky.

items.prompt: When I left the house, the sun ___ and the birds were singing.

hints.he: זה תיאור של רקע בסיפור.
hints.en: This describes the background of a story.

explanation.he: תיאור רקע בסיפור בא ב־Past Progressive: the sun was shining. the sun הוא it, ולכן was.
explanation.en: Background in a story uses the Past Progressive: the sun was shining.

items.audioText: When I left the house, the sun was shining and the birds were singing.

items.prompt: When I was little, I ___ be afraid of dogs.

hints.he: מדובר במצב שהיה פעם, וכבר לא נכון.
hints.en: This is a past state that is no longer true.

explanation.he: used to + פועל בסיס = משהו שהיה נכון פעם, והיום כבר לא. במשפט חיובי כותבים used עם d.
explanation.en: used to + base verb = something true in the past, not now. In positive sentences write used with d.

items.audioText: When I was little, I used to be afraid of dogs.

items.prompt: My grandfather ___ smoke, but he stopped years ago.

hints.he: he stopped years ago: זה הרגל שהיה ונגמר.
hints.en: he stopped years ago: a habit that ended.

explanation.he: used to = הרגל בעבר שכבר לא קיים. אין לו צורת הווה, ולכן אין uses to.
explanation.en: used to = a past habit that stopped. It has no present form, so there is no uses to.

items.audioText: My grandfather used to smoke, but he stopped years ago.

items.prompt: ___ you use to play an instrument when you were a kid?

hints.he: use to הוא כמו פועל רגיל בעבר.
hints.en: use to works like a normal past verb.

explanation.he: שאלה: Did + נושא + use to. אחרי did כותבים use בלי d.
explanation.en: Question: Did + subject + use to. After did, write use without d.

items.audioText: Did you use to play an instrument when you were a kid?

items.prompt: We didn't ___ have a car. We walked everywhere.

hints.he: מה קורה לפועל אחרי didn't?
hints.en: What happens to the verb after didn't?

explanation.he: אחרי didn't בא פועל בסיס, ולכן didn't use to, בלי d. אי אפשר לוותר על to.
explanation.en: After didn't use the base verb, so didn't use to, without d. Do not leave out to.

items.audioText: We didn't use to have a car. We walked everywhere.

items.prompt: My mom used to ___ in a bank before she became a teacher.

hints.he: used to + ? איזו צורה של הפועל?
hints.en: used to + ? Which verb form?

explanation.he: used to + פועל בסיס: used to work. used to working שייך למבנה אחר (be used to = רגיל ל).
explanation.en: used to + base verb: used to work. used to + -ing belongs to be used to (= accustomed to).

items.audioText: My mom used to work in a bank before she became a teacher.

items.prompt: There ___ be a cinema here, but now it's a supermarket.

hints.he: but now: המצב השתנה.
hints.en: but now: the situation changed.

explanation.he: There used to be = פעם היה כאן. המצב כבר לא נכון היום.
explanation.en: There used to be = there was in the past, but not now.

items.audioText: There used to be a cinema here, but now it's a supermarket.

items.prompt: I ___ to play tennis, but now I prefer swimming. (use)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: במשפט חיובי כותבים used to, עם d.
feedback.en: In a positive sentence write used to, with d.

feedback.he: used to מדבר על עבר. אין צורת הווה.
feedback.en: used to is about the past. There is no present form.

hints.he: but now: זה הרגל שהיה פעם.
hints.en: but now: it was a habit in the past.

explanation.he: used to + פועל בסיס = הרגל בעבר. במשפט חיובי: used.
explanation.en: used to + base verb = a past habit. In a positive sentence: used.

items.audioText: I used to play tennis, but now I prefer swimming.

items.prompt: I ___ to waking up early now, so it doesn't bother me.

hints.he: now: זה מצב של היום, לא הרגל שנגמר. ואחרי to בא waking.
hints.en: now: this is today, not a past habit. And to is followed by waking.

explanation.he: be used to + ing = להיות רגיל ל. I am used to waking up early. used to + פועל בסיס = הרגל בעבר. אלה שני מבנים שונים.
explanation.en: be used to + -ing = be accustomed to. used to + base verb = a past habit. They are different structures.

items.audioText: I am used to waking up early now, so it doesn't bother me.

items.prompt: When we lived in London, we ___ go to the park every Sunday.

hints.he: זה הרגל חוזר בעבר.
hints.en: This is a repeated habit in the past.

explanation.he: would + פועל בסיס יכול לתאר הרגל חוזר בעבר, בדיוק כמו used to: we would go every Sunday.
explanation.en: would + base verb can describe a repeated past habit, like used to: we would go every Sunday.

items.audioText: When we lived in London, we would go to the park every Sunday.

items.prompt: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.

hints.he: רואים סימן עכשיו (עננים) למה שיקרה.
hints.en: We can see a sign now (clouds) of what will happen.

hints.he: לפני going to צריך פועל עזר שמתאים ל־it.
hints.en: going to needs a helping verb that fits it.

explanation.he: כשיש סימן עכשיו שמשהו יקרה, משתמשים ב־be going to + פועל בסיס: It is going to rain.
explanation.en: When there is a sign now, use be going to + base verb: It is going to rain.

items.audioText: Look at those dark clouds! It is going to rain.

items.prompt: "The phone is ringing." "Don't worry, I ___ answer it."

hints.he: ההחלטה נעשית ברגע הדיבור.
hints.en: The decision is made at the moment of speaking.

explanation.he: החלטה של הרגע = will + פועל בסיס: I will answer it (I'll answer it).
explanation.en: A decision made now = will + base verb: I will answer it.

items.audioText: "The phone is ringing." "Don't worry, I will answer it."

items.prompt: We ___ visit the museum tomorrow. We planned it last week.

hints.he: תוכנית שכבר הוחלטה. איך בונים going to?
hints.en: A plan that was already made. How is going to built?

explanation.he: תוכנית = am / is / are + going to + פועל בסיס. כל שלושת החלקים חובה: are going to visit.
explanation.en: A plan = am / is / are + going to + base verb. All three parts are needed: are going to visit.

items.audioText: We are going to visit the museum tomorrow. We planned it last week.

items.prompt: I think it ___ be sunny tomorrow.

hints.he: I think + תחזית לעתיד.
hints.en: I think + a prediction about the future.

explanation.he: תחזית אחרי I think בדרך כלל באה עם will + פועל בסיס: I think it will be sunny.
explanation.en: A prediction after I think usually takes will + base verb: I think it will be sunny.

items.audioText: I think it will be sunny tomorrow.

items.prompt: Don't worry, I ___ be late tomorrow. I promise.

hints.he: tomorrow = עתיד. מה השלילה של will?
hints.en: tomorrow = future. What is the negative of will?

explanation.he: השלילה של will היא will not, או בקיצור won't: I won't be late.
explanation.en: The negative of will is will not, or won't: I won't be late.

items.audioText: Don't worry, I won't be late tomorrow. I promise.

items.prompt: Watch out! That glass is going to ___ off the table. (fall)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: אחרי going to בא פועל בסיס.
feedback.en: After going to use the base verb.

feedback.he: אחרי going to בא פועל בסיס, בלי s.
feedback.en: After going to use the base verb, without -s.

hints.he: איזו צורה באה אחרי to?
hints.en: Which form comes after to?

explanation.he: going to + פועל בסיס: is going to fall. רואים סימן עכשיו שזה יקרה.
explanation.en: going to + base verb: is going to fall. There is a sign now.

items.audioText: Watch out! That glass is going to fall off the table.

items.prompt: I'll call you when I ___ home.

hints.he: when כאן מדבר על עתיד, אבל אחריו לא בא will.
hints.en: when here talks about the future, but will does not follow it.

explanation.he: אחרי when, as soon as, before, after, until שמדברים על עתיד משתמשים בהווה פשוט: when I get home. בעברית אומרים "כשאגיע" בעתיד, ולכן קל לטעות.
explanation.en: After when, as soon as, before, after and until about the future, use the Present Simple: when I get home.

items.audioText: I'll call you when I get home.

items.prompt: As soon as she ___, we will start dinner.

hints.he: as soon as היא מילת זמן כמו when.
hints.en: as soon as is a time word, like when.

explanation.he: אחרי as soon as בעתיד: Present Simple. she הוא גוף שלישי, ולכן arrives.
explanation.en: After as soon as about the future, use the Present Simple. With she: arrives.

items.audioText: As soon as she arrives, we will start dinner.

items.prompt: We ___ my grandparents tomorrow evening. We bought the train tickets yesterday.

hints.he: הכרטיסים כבר נקנו: זה סידור שנקבע מראש.
hints.en: The tickets are bought: it is a fixed arrangement.

explanation.he: סידור שכבר נקבע לעתיד הקרוב (כרטיסים, פגישה) בא לרוב ב־Present Progressive: We are visiting... tomorrow.
explanation.en: A fixed arrangement for the near future often uses the Present Progressive: We are visiting... tomorrow.

items.audioText: We are visiting my grandparents tomorrow evening. We bought the train tickets yesterday.

items.prompt: Hurry up! According to the website, the movie ___ at 7:30.

hints.he: זה לוח זמנים קבוע של קולנוע.
hints.en: This is a fixed cinema timetable.

explanation.he: לוח זמנים רשמי, גם בעתיד, בא ב־Present Simple: the movie starts at 7:30.
explanation.en: An official timetable, even in the future, uses the Present Simple: the movie starts at 7:30.

items.audioText: Hurry up! According to the website, the movie starts at 7:30.

items.prompt: When I ___ my homework, I'll go out with my friends. (finish)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: אחרי when שמדבר על עתיד לא שמים will.
feedback.en: After when about the future, do not use will.

feedback.he: זה עתיד, לא עבר. אחרי when בא הווה פשוט.
feedback.en: This is the future, not the past. Use the Present Simple after when.

hints.he: החלק של when מדבר על עתיד. איזה זמן בא אחרי when?
hints.en: The when part is about the future. Which tense follows when?

explanation.he: When I finish..., I'll go out. אחרי when: הווה פשוט (אפשר גם have finished). בחלק השני: will.
explanation.en: When I finish..., I'll go out. Present Simple after when (have finished is also possible), will in the other part.

items.audioText: When I finish my homework, I'll go out with my friends.

items.prompt: We'll wait here until the rain ___. (stop)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: אחרי until שמדבר על עתיד לא שמים will.
feedback.en: After until about the future, do not use will.

feedback.he: the rain זה it, ולכן צריך s.
feedback.en: the rain is it, so add -s.

hints.he: until היא מילת זמן. the rain = it.
hints.en: until is a time word. the rain = it.

explanation.he: until + Present Simple: until the rain stops. אפשר גם until the rain has stopped.
explanation.en: until + Present Simple: until the rain stops. until the rain has stopped is also possible.

items.audioText: We'll wait here until the rain stops.

items.prompt: Before she ___ tomorrow, she'll give you her new address. (leave)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: אחרי before שמדבר על עתיד לא שמים will.
feedback.en: After before about the future, do not use will.

feedback.he: she הוא גוף שלישי, ולכן צריך s.
feedback.en: she is third person, so add -s.

hints.he: before היא מילת זמן. she = גוף שלישי.
hints.en: before is a time word. she = third person.

explanation.he: before + Present Simple גם כשמדברים על מחר: Before she leaves tomorrow...
explanation.en: before + Present Simple, even about tomorrow: Before she leaves tomorrow...

items.audioText: Before she leaves tomorrow, she'll give you her new address.

items.prompt: "Are you free on Friday evening?" "Sorry, I ___ dinner with my cousins. We booked a table last week."

hints.he: יש הזמנה של שולחן: זה סידור קבוע.
hints.en: A table is booked: it is a fixed arrangement.

explanation.he: סידור אישי שנקבע מראש: Present Progressive. I am having dinner with my cousins on Friday.
explanation.en: A personal arrangement made in advance: Present Progressive. I am having dinner on Friday.

items.audioText: "Are you free on Friday evening?" "Sorry, I am having dinner with my cousins. We booked a table last week."

items.prompt: "I can't open this jar." "Give it to me. I ___ it for you."

hints.he: זו הצעה לעזור, שנאמרת ברגע זה.
hints.en: This is an offer to help, made right now.

explanation.he: הצעה או החלטה של הרגע: will + פועל בסיס. I'll open it for you.
explanation.en: An offer or a decision made now: will + base verb. I'll open it for you.

items.audioText: "I can't open this jar." "Give it to me. I will open it for you."

items.prompt: I have ___ that movie three times. (see)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After have use the third form.
see is irregular.

hints.he: have + צורה שלישית. see → saw → ?
hints.en: have + third form. see → saw → ?

explanation.he: see → saw → seen. אחרי have: seen.
explanation.en: see → saw → seen. After have: seen.

items.audioText: I have seen that movie three times.

items.prompt: She has ___ to Paris twice. (be)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After has use the third form.
After has use the third form.

hints.he: be → was / were → ?
hints.en: be → was / were → ?

explanation.he: be → was / were → been. has been to = ביקרה ב.
explanation.en: be → was / were → been. has been to = has visited.

items.audioText: She has been to Paris twice.

items.prompt: We have already ___ lunch. (eat)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After have use the third form.
eat is irregular.

hints.he: eat → ate → ?
hints.en: eat → ate → ?

explanation.he: eat → ate → eaten. have already eaten.
explanation.en: eat → ate → eaten. have already eaten.

items.audioText: We have already eaten lunch.

items.prompt: Have you ever ___ a horse? (ride)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After have use the third form.
ride is irregular.

hints.he: ride → rode → ?
hints.en: ride → rode → ?

explanation.he: ride → rode → ridden. Have you ever ridden...? = האם אי פעם רכבת?
explanation.en: ride → rode → ridden. Have you ever ridden...? asks about life experience.

items.audioText: Have you ever ridden a horse?

items.prompt: Oh no! He has ___ his phone again! (lose)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: lose is irregular.
After has use the third form.

hints.he: lose חריג. הצורה השנייה והשלישית זהות.
hints.en: lose is irregular. The second and third forms are the same.

explanation.he: lose → lost → lost. has lost = איבד, והטלפון עדיין חסר.
explanation.en: lose → lost → lost. has lost: the phone is still missing.

items.audioText: Oh no! He has lost his phone again!

items.prompt: They have ___ in this town since 2015. (live)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After have use the third form.

feedback.he: כאן צריך צורה שלישית, לא ing.
feedback.en: You need the third form here, not -ing.

hints.he: have + צורה שלישית. live הוא פועל רגיל.
hints.en: have + third form. live is a regular verb.

explanation.he: פועל רגיל: הצורה השלישית זהה לעבר. have lived. בעברית "הם גרים פה מאז 2015", באנגלית Present Perfect.
explanation.en: Regular verb: the third form is like the past. have lived. English uses the Present Perfect here.

items.audioText: They have lived in this town since 2015.

items.prompt: I have lived in Jerusalem ___ ten years.

hints.he: ten years הוא משך זמן או נקודת התחלה?
hints.en: Is ten years a length of time or a starting point?

explanation.he: for + משך זמן (for ten years). since + נקודת התחלה (since 2016).
explanation.en: for + a length of time (for ten years). since + a starting point (since 2016).

items.audioText: I have lived in Jerusalem for ten years.

items.prompt: She has been my best friend ___ first grade.

hints.he: first grade הוא נקודת התחלה.
hints.en: first grade is a starting point.

explanation.he: since + נקודת התחלה: since first grade. בעברית "מאז כיתה א'".
explanation.en: since + starting point: since first grade.

items.audioText: She has been my best friend since first grade.

items.prompt: We ___ each other for six years, and we are still close friends.

hints.he: for six years + עד היום. איזה זמן מחבר עבר להווה?
hints.en: for six years until today. Which tense joins past and present?

explanation.he: בעברית "אנחנו מכירים שש שנים" בהווה. באנגלית: We have known each other for six years. know הוא פועל מצב, ולכן לא בא ב־ing.
explanation.en: Hebrew uses the present. English: We have known each other for six years. know is a state verb, so no -ing.

items.audioText: We have known each other for six years, and we are still close friends.

items.prompt: Have you finished your homework ___?

hints.he: מילה שבאה בסוף שאלה ב־Present Perfect.
hints.en: A word at the end of a Present Perfect question.

explanation.he: yet בא בסוף שאלות ושלילה: Have you finished yet? = כבר סיימת?
explanation.en: yet comes at the end of questions and negatives: Have you finished yet?

items.audioText: Have you finished your homework yet?

items.prompt: I haven't cleaned my room ___.

hints.he: המשפט בשלילה. איזו מילה באה בסוף משפט שלילי?
hints.en: The sentence is negative. Which word ends a negative sentence?

explanation.he: yet בשלילה = עדיין לא. already בא במשפט חיובי.
explanation.en: yet in negatives = not until now. already goes in positive sentences.

items.audioText: I haven't cleaned my room yet.

items.prompt: Don't make coffee for me. I have ___ had two cups.

hints.he: המשפט חיובי, ובא בין have לפועל.
hints.en: The sentence is positive, and the word sits between have and the verb.

explanation.he: already = כבר, במשפט חיובי, בין have לצורה השלישית: I have already had two cups.
explanation.en: already = before now, in positive sentences, between have and the verb.

items.audioText: Don't make coffee for me. I have already had two cups.

items.prompt: ___ you ever been to Eilat?

hints.he: been היא צורה שלישית. איזה פועל עזר בא איתה?
hints.en: been is a third form. Which helping verb goes with it?

explanation.he: been בא אחרי have / has. עם you: Have you ever been...? = היית פעם ב...?
explanation.en: been follows have / has. With you: Have you ever been...?

items.audioText: Have you ever been to Eilat?

items.prompt: I have ___ finished the test. I'm so relieved!

hints.he: הפעולה הסתיימה לפני רגע.
hints.en: The action finished a moment ago.

explanation.he: just = הרגע. I have just finished = סיימתי הרגע.
explanation.en: just = a very short time ago. I have just finished.

items.audioText: I have just finished the test. I'm so relieved!

items.prompt: How long ___ in this apartment? Since you were born?

hints.he: השאלה על תקופה שהתחילה בעבר ונמשכת עד היום.
hints.en: The question is about a period from the past until now.

explanation.he: בעברית שואלים בהווה: "כמה זמן גרים פה?". באנגלית: How long have you lived here?
explanation.en: Hebrew uses the present. English: How long have you lived here?

items.audioText: How long have you lived in this apartment? Since you were born?

items.prompt: This is the first time I ___ snow!

hints.he: This is the first time מתחבר תמיד לאותו זמן.
hints.en: This is the first time always goes with one tense.

explanation.he: אחרי It's / This is the first time משתמשים ב־Present Perfect: This is the first time I have seen snow. בעברית אומרים "אני רואה".
explanation.en: After This is the first time, use the Present Perfect: the first time I have seen snow.

items.audioText: This is the first time I have seen snow!

items.prompt: My sister ___ to London. She'll be back next week.

hints.he: האחות עדיין בלונדון, או שכבר חזרה?
hints.en: Is the sister still in London, or is she back?

explanation.he: has gone to = נסע ועדיין שם. has been to = ביקר וחזר. היא חוזרת רק בשבוע הבא, ולכן has gone.
explanation.en: has gone to = went and is still there. has been to = visited and came back.

items.audioText: My sister has gone to London. She'll be back next week.

items.prompt: I ___ to Rome twice. I loved it both times, and I'd like to go again.

hints.he: have + צורה שלישית. be → was / were → ?
hints.en: have + third form. be → was / were → ?

explanation.he: have been to = ביקרתי וחזרתי. been היא הצורה השלישית של be. went היא צורת עבר ולא באה אחרי have.
explanation.en: have been to = visited and came back. been is the third form of be. went is the past form, so it cannot follow have.

items.audioText: I have been to Rome twice. I loved it both times, and I'd like to go again.

items.prompt: I ___ my wallet yesterday.

hints.he: yesterday הוא זמן עבר מוגדר.
hints.en: yesterday is a finished time.

explanation.he: עם yesterday, last week, ago משתמשים ב־Past Simple: I lost.
explanation.en: With yesterday, last week or ago, use the Past Simple: I lost.

items.audioText: I lost my wallet yesterday.

items.prompt: We ___ to Greece in 2019.

hints.he: in 2019 הוא זמן עבר מוגדר.
hints.en: in 2019 is a finished time.

explanation.he: שנה מוגדרת בעבר = Past Simple: We went to Greece in 2019.
explanation.en: A finished year = Past Simple: We went to Greece in 2019.

items.audioText: We went to Greece in 2019.

items.prompt: I ___ him since we finished school.

hints.he: since + עד היום: תקופה שעוד לא נגמרה.
hints.en: since + until now: a period that is not over.

explanation.he: since מחבר עבר להווה, ולכן Present Perfect: I haven't seen him since... בעברית "לא ראיתי אותו מאז" בעבר, אבל באנגלית צריך have.
explanation.en: since links the past to now, so use the Present Perfect: I haven't seen him since...

items.audioText: I haven't seen him since we finished school.

items.prompt: Shakespeare ___ many famous plays before he died in 1616.

hints.he: Shakespeare חי לפני מאות שנים. התקופה שלו נגמרה.
hints.en: Shakespeare lived centuries ago. His time is over.

explanation.he: כשהתקופה נגמרה (אדם שכבר לא בחיים), משתמשים ב־Past Simple: Shakespeare wrote.
explanation.en: When the period is over, use the Past Simple: Shakespeare wrote.

items.audioText: Shakespeare wrote many famous plays before he died in 1616.

items.prompt: When ___ you start learning English?

hints.he: When שואל על זמן מדויק בעבר.
hints.en: When asks about an exact time in the past.

explanation.he: שאלה עם When על עבר: Past Simple. When did you start? לא שואלים When have you...
explanation.en: When about the past takes the Past Simple: When did you start?

items.audioText: When did you start learning English?

items.prompt: I ___ three tests so far this week.

hints.he: so far = עד עכשיו. איך בונים Present Perfect עם I?
hints.en: so far = until now. How is the Present Perfect built with I?

explanation.he: so far this week = התקופה עדיין לא נגמרה, ולכן Present Perfect: have + had. עם I: have, לא has.
explanation.en: so far this week is not over, so use the Present Perfect: have had. With I: have.

items.audioText: I have had three tests so far this week.

items.prompt: She ___ in Haifa for five years, but then she moved to Tel Aviv.

hints.he: but then she moved: התקופה בחיפה נגמרה.
hints.en: but then she moved: the Haifa period is over.

explanation.he: תקופה שנגמרה בעבר = Past Simple, גם עם for: She lived there for five years.
explanation.en: A finished period = Past Simple, even with for: She lived there for five years.

items.audioText: She lived in Haifa for five years, but then she moved to Tel Aviv.

items.prompt: She ___ in Haifa for five years now, and she loves it there.

hints.he: for five years now: היא עדיין גרה שם.
hints.en: for five years now: she still lives there.

explanation.he: תקופה שהתחילה בעבר ונמשכת עד היום = Present Perfect: She has lived there for five years.
explanation.en: A period from the past until now = Present Perfect: She has lived there for five years.

items.audioText: She has lived in Haifa for five years now, and she loves it there.

items.prompt: I ___ him two years ago at summer camp. (meet)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: With ago, use the Past Simple.
meet is irregular.

hints.he: two years ago = זמן עבר מוגדר. meet הוא חריג.
hints.en: two years ago = a finished time. meet is irregular.

explanation.he: ago = Past Simple. meet → met.
explanation.en: ago = Past Simple. meet → met.

items.audioText: I met him two years ago at summer camp.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: I have visited London last year.
I have visit London last year.
I was visit London last year.

hints.he: last year הוא זמן עבר מוגדר.
hints.en: last year is a finished time.

explanation.he: last year = Past Simple: I visited. Present Perfect לא בא עם last year.
explanation.en: last year = Past Simple: I visited. The Present Perfect does not go with last year.

items.audioText: I visited London last year.

items.prompt: How many films ___ so far this year?

hints.he: so far this year = השנה עוד לא נגמרה.
hints.en: so far this year = the year is not over.

explanation.he: so far = עד עכשיו, ולכן Present Perfect: How many films have you watched so far?
explanation.en: so far = until now, so use the Present Perfect: How many films have you watched?

items.audioText: How many films have you watched so far this year?

items.prompt: I ___ for you for an hour! Where were you?

hints.he: for an hour: ההמתנה התחילה לפני שעה ונמשכה עד עכשיו.
hints.en: for an hour: the waiting began an hour ago and lasted until now.

explanation.he: בעברית "אני מחכה לך כבר שעה" בהווה. באנגלית פעולה מתמשכת עד עכשיו: have been + ing. I have been waiting for an hour.
explanation.en: Hebrew uses the present. English uses have been + -ing for an action lasting until now.

items.audioText: I have been waiting for you for an hour! Where were you?

items.prompt: It ___ since this morning, and the streets are full of water.

hints.he: since this morning: הגשם התחיל בבוקר ונמשך עד עכשיו.
hints.en: since this morning: the rain started in the morning and continues.

explanation.he: since + פעולה מתמשכת = has / have been + ing. it הולך עם has.
explanation.en: since + an ongoing action = has / have been + -ing. it goes with has.

items.audioText: It has been raining since this morning, and the streets are full of water.

items.prompt: She has been ___ English for three years. (learn)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: אחרי been בפעולה מתמשכת צריך ing.
feedback.en: After been in a continuous action you need -ing.

feedback.he: אחרי been בפעולה מתמשכת צריך ing.
feedback.en: After been in a continuous action you need -ing.
After been you need -ing.

hints.he: has been + ?
hints.en: has been + ?

explanation.he: has been + ing: has been learning. הלימוד התחיל לפני שלוש שנים ועוד נמשך.
explanation.en: has been + -ing: has been learning. It started three years ago and continues.

items.audioText: She has been learning English for three years.

items.prompt: How long have you been ___ here? (wait)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After been you need -ing.

feedback.he: אחרי been בפעולה מתמשכת צריך ing.
feedback.en: After been in a continuous action you need -ing.

hints.he: How long + have been + ?
hints.en: How long + have been + ?

explanation.he: How long have you been waiting? בעברית שואלים בהווה ("כמה זמן מחכים?"). באנגלית have been + ing.
explanation.en: How long have you been waiting? Hebrew uses the present; English uses have been + -ing.

items.audioText: How long have you been waiting here?

items.prompt: Your eyes are red. Have you been ___? (cry)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: כמעט. ב־ing לא משנים את ה־y.
feedback.en: Almost. Keep the y before -ing.
After been here you need -ing.

hints.he: רואים תוצאה של פעולה שנמשכה עד לא מזמן.
hints.en: We see the result of an action that went on until recently.

explanation.he: have been + ing מסביר תוצאה שרואים עכשיו: Have you been crying? cry → crying, ה־y נשארת.
explanation.en: have been + -ing explains a result we see now. cry → crying, the y stays.

items.audioText: Your eyes are red. Have you been crying?

items.prompt: You look tired and you're all sweaty. ___ you been running?

hints.he: been running: איזה פועל עזר בא לפני been?
hints.en: been running: which helping verb comes before been?

explanation.he: Present Perfect Progressive בשאלה: Have + you + been + ing.
explanation.en: Present Perfect Progressive question: Have + you + been + -ing.

items.audioText: You look tired and you're all sweaty. Have you been running?

items.prompt: My brother ___ video games since lunch, and he still hasn't done his homework.

hints.he: since lunch: הפעולה התחילה בצהריים ועוד נמשכת.
hints.en: since lunch: it started at lunch and continues.

explanation.he: since + פעולה שנמשכת עד עכשיו: has been playing. my brother = he, ולכן has.
explanation.en: since + an action lasting until now: has been playing. my brother = he, so has.

items.audioText: My brother has been playing video games since lunch, and he still hasn't done his homework.

items.prompt: I ___ three emails this morning, and now I can finally relax.

hints.he: three emails: יש מספר של דברים שהסתיימו.
hints.en: three emails: a number of finished things.

explanation.he: כשסופרים כמה דברים הסתיימו, משתמשים ב־Present Perfect: I have written three emails. have been writing מדגיש את התהליך, לא את הכמות.
explanation.en: When we count finished things, use the Present Perfect: I have written three emails. have been writing stresses the activity, not the number.

items.audioText: I have written three emails this morning, and now I can finally relax.

items.prompt: We ___ each other since kindergarten.

hints.he: know הוא פועל מצב.
hints.en: know is a state verb.

explanation.he: פעלי מצב (know, like, have במשמעות בעלות) לא באים ב־ing. לכן Present Perfect רגיל: have known.
explanation.en: State verbs (know, like) have no -ing form, so use the simple Present Perfect: have known.

items.audioText: We have known each other since kindergarten.

items.prompt: They have been ___ the house all week, and it's almost finished. (paint)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: all week + been: צריך ing כדי להראות פעולה מתמשכת.
feedback.en: all week + been: use -ing to show a continuing action.
After been you need -ing.

hints.he: all week + it's almost finished: הפעולה עוד לא נגמרה.
hints.en: all week + it's almost finished: the action is not over.

explanation.he: have been + ing לפעולה שנמשכת עד עכשיו ועוד לא נגמרה: have been painting.
explanation.en: have been + -ing for an action that continues until now: have been painting.

items.audioText: They have been painting the house all week, and it's almost finished.

items.prompt: When we got to the station, the train ___ already left. We had to wait an hour.

hints.he: הרכבת יצאה לפני שהגענו. שתי פעולות בעבר.
hints.en: The train left before we arrived. Two past actions.

explanation.he: הפעולה המוקדמת יותר בעבר: had + צורה שלישית. the train had already left.
explanation.en: The earlier past action: had + past participle. the train had already left.

items.audioText: When we got to the station, the train had already left. We had to wait an hour.

items.prompt: When I arrived at the party, Tom ___ home, so I didn't see him at all.

hints.he: Tom יצא לפני שהגעתי, או באותו רגע?
hints.en: Did Tom leave before I came, or at the same moment?

explanation.he: Tom הלך לפני שהגעתי, ולכן Past Perfect: had gone. When I arrived, Tom went home פירושו שהוא הלך ברגע שהגעתי.
explanation.en: Tom left before I came, so: had gone. Tom went home would mean he left when I arrived.

items.audioText: When I arrived at the party, Tom had gone home, so I didn't see him at all.

items.prompt: I couldn't get in because I had ___ my keys at school. (forget)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After had use the third form.
forget is irregular.

hints.he: forget → forgot → ?
hints.en: forget → forgot → ?

explanation.he: forget → forgot → forgotten. had + צורה שלישית: had forgotten.
explanation.en: forget → forgot → forgotten. had + third form: had forgotten.

items.audioText: I couldn't get in because I had forgotten my keys at school.

items.prompt: Before that trip, she had never ___ such a tall building. (see)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After had use the third form.

hints.he: had + צורה שלישית. see → saw → ?
hints.en: had + third form. see → saw → ?

explanation.he: had never seen = מעולם לא ראתה עד אותו זמן בעבר.
explanation.en: had never seen = never before that time in the past.

items.audioText: Before that trip, she had never seen such a tall building.

items.prompt: By the time the police arrived, the thief had ___. (escape)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: After had use the third form.

hints.he: had + צורה שלישית. escape הוא פועל רגיל.
hints.en: had + third form. escape is a regular verb.

explanation.he: By the time + עבר: הפעולה האחרת כבר קרתה קודם. had escaped.
explanation.en: By the time + past: the other action happened earlier. had escaped.

items.audioText: By the time the police arrived, the thief had escaped.

items.prompt: He was hungry because he hadn't ___ all day. (eat)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: אחרי had / hadn't באה הצורה השלישית.
feedback.en: After had / hadn't use the third form.
After hadn't use the third form.

hints.he: eat → ate → ?
hints.en: eat → ate → ?

explanation.he: hadn't eaten: הסיבה לרעב קרתה לפני כן.
explanation.en: hadn't eaten: the reason for the hunger came earlier.

items.audioText: He was hungry because he hadn't eaten all day.

items.prompt: By the time I finished my homework, everyone ___ to bed.

hints.he: by the time: מה קרה קודם?
hints.en: by the time: what happened first?

explanation.he: by the time + Past Simple, ובחלק השני Past Perfect: everyone had gone to bed. כולם הלכו לישון לפני שסיימתי.
explanation.en: by the time + Past Simple, and Past Perfect in the other part: everyone had gone to bed.

items.audioText: By the time I finished my homework, everyone had gone to bed.

items.prompt: I ___ the movie before, so I knew the ending.

hints.he: הסיפור בעבר (knew). הצפייה הייתה עוד קודם.
hints.en: The story is in the past (knew). The watching was even earlier.

explanation.he: כשמספרים בעבר ומשהו קרה עוד קודם: had + צורה שלישית. had seen.
explanation.en: When telling about the past and something happened even earlier: had + third form. had seen.

items.audioText: I had seen the movie before, so I knew the ending.

items.prompt: She was upset because her friends ___ her birthday.

hints.he: was upset בעבר. השכחה קרתה לפני כן.
hints.en: was upset is past. The forgetting came before that.

explanation.he: סיבה בעבר שקרתה לפני פעולה אחרת בעבר: had forgotten.
explanation.en: A past reason that happened before another past event: had forgotten.

items.audioText: She was upset because her friends had forgotten her birthday.

items.prompt: ___ you ever been abroad before you moved to Israel?

hints.he: before you moved: מדובר על זמן לפני נקודה בעבר.
hints.en: before you moved: a time before a past point.

explanation.he: ניסיון עד נקודה בעבר: Had + you + ever + been.
explanation.en: Experience up to a past point: Had you ever been...?

items.audioText: Had you ever been abroad before you moved to Israel?

items.prompt: After she ___ her exams, she went on a trip.

hints.he: קודם המבחנים, אחר כך הטיול. שניהם בעבר.
hints.en: First the exams, then the trip. Both are past.

explanation.he: had + צורה שלישית לפעולה הראשונה: After she had finished... she went. אחרי after אפשר גם finished, כי after כבר מראה את הסדר.
explanation.en: had + past participle for the first action: After she had finished... she went. After after, finished is also fine, because after already shows the order.

items.audioText: After she had finished her exams, she went on a trip.

items.prompt: English ___ in many countries.

hints.he: השפה לא מדברת. אנשים מדברים אותה.
hints.en: The language does not speak. People speak it.

explanation.he: כשהנושא מקבל את הפעולה, משתמשים בסביל: be + צורה שלישית. English is spoken.
explanation.en: When the subject receives the action, use the passive: be + past participle. English is spoken.

items.audioText: English is spoken in many countries.

items.prompt: Hebrew ___ from right to left.

hints.he: השפה לא כותבת. כותבים אותה.
hints.en: The language does not write. People write it.

explanation.he: סביל בהווה: is / are + צורה שלישית. Hebrew is written from right to left.
explanation.en: Present passive: is / are + past participle. Hebrew is written from right to left.

items.audioText: Hebrew is written from right to left.

items.prompt: This bridge was ___ in 1990. (build)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.en: build is irregular.

feedback.he: אחרי was בסביל באה הצורה השלישית.
feedback.en: After was in the passive use the third form.

hints.he: was + צורה שלישית. build הוא חריג.
hints.en: was + third form. build is irregular.

explanation.he: סביל בעבר: was / were + צורה שלישית. build → built → built.
explanation.en: Past passive: was / were + past participle. build → built → built.

items.audioText: This bridge was built in 1990.

items.prompt: In the past, letters were ___ by hand. (write)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: אחרי were בסביל באה הצורה השלישית, לא העבר.
feedback.en: After were in the passive use the third form, not the past.
Almost. written has two t's.

hints.he: write → wrote → ?
hints.en: write → wrote → ?

explanation.he: were + צורה שלישית: were written.
explanation.en: were + past participle: were written.

items.audioText: In the past, letters were written by hand.

items.prompt: Cheese is ___ from milk. (make)

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the verb

feedback.he: אחרי is בסביל באה הצורה השלישית.
feedback.en: After is in the passive use the third form.
make is irregular.

hints.he: is + צורה שלישית. make → made → ?
hints.en: is + third form. make → made → ?

explanation.he: סביל בהווה: is made. made from = עשוי מ.
explanation.en: Present passive: is made. made from = produced from.

items.audioText: Cheese is made from milk.

items.prompt: The Mona Lisa was painted ___ Leonardo da Vinci.

hints.he: איזו מילה מציגה את מי שעשה את הפעולה בסביל?
hints.en: Which word introduces the doer in a passive sentence?

explanation.he: בסביל, מי שעשה את הפעולה בא אחרי by. בעברית "על ידי", ולפעמים אומרים "מ", ולכן יש מי שכותב from.
explanation.en: In the passive, the doer comes after by.

items.audioText: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.

items.prompt: My bike ___ last night!

hints.he: האופניים לא גנבו. מישהו גנב אותם. ומתי?
hints.en: The bike did not steal. Someone stole it. And when?

explanation.he: last night = עבר, ולכן was + צורה שלישית: was stolen. steal → stole → stolen.
explanation.en: last night = past, so was + past participle: was stolen.

items.audioText: My bike was stolen last night!

items.prompt: Most of these phones ___ in China.

hints.he: these phones = רבים. הטלפונים לא מייצרים.
hints.en: these phones = plural. Phones do not make things.

explanation.he: סביל ברבים בהווה: are + צורה שלישית. are made.
explanation.en: Plural present passive: are + past participle. are made.

items.audioText: Most of these phones are made in China.

items.prompt: The windows in our school ___ every week.

hints.he: החלונות לא מנקים. מנקים אותם.
hints.en: The windows do not clean. Someone cleans them.

explanation.he: הרגל + סביל: are + צורה שלישית. The windows are cleaned every week.
explanation.en: Habit + passive: are + past participle. The windows are cleaned every week.

items.audioText: The windows in our school are cleaned every week.

items.prompt: The results of the competition ___ tomorrow morning.

hints.he: tomorrow = עתיד. התוצאות לא מודיעות. מודיעים עליהן.
hints.en: tomorrow = future. Results do not announce. Someone announces them.

explanation.he: סביל בעתיד: will be + צורה שלישית. will be announced.
explanation.en: Future passive: will be + past participle. will be announced.

items.audioText: The results of the competition will be announced tomorrow morning.

items.prompt: Which sentence is correct?

options.text: The cake was eaten by the kids.
The cake was ate by the kids.
The cake eaten by the kids.
The cake was eaten from the kids.

hints.he: בסביל צריך be, צורה שלישית, ו־by.
hints.en: The passive needs be, the third form, and by.

explanation.he: was + eaten + by: The cake was eaten by the kids.
explanation.en: was + eaten + by: The cake was eaten by the kids.

items.audioText: The cake was eaten by the kids.

items.prompt: The project must ___ by Sunday.

hints.he: אחרי must בא be. ומה אחריו?
hints.en: must is followed by be. What comes next?

explanation.he: סביל עם מודאל: must / can / should + be + צורה שלישית. must be finished.
explanation.en: Passive with a modal: must / can / should + be + past participle. must be finished.

items.audioText: The project must be finished by Sunday.

items.prompt: The car ___ yet. It's still dirty.

hints.he: yet = עד עכשיו. המכונית לא שוטפת. שוטפים אותה.
